title: Nazca and Paracas cranial elongation rituals

tellings.quote: The final thing that the Nazca and Paracas people practiced were cranial deformation or skull elongation rituals.

plain: The ancient Nazca and Paracas peoples of Peru practised rituals that reshaped the skull and made it longer. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as one of several customs of those cultures, in an episode about strange three-fingered bodies said to come from Peru.
